title_as_printed: Identifying Mild Behavioral and Neurocognitive Impairment in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (MBNI-ALS) Provides Key Prognostic Insights

registry_codes.Sample_N_Approx: 201 ALS patients (67 consecutive months of recruitment; median 15-month follow-up)

Task_Type.reason: ALS patients are classified with the MBNI framework (NC/MCI/MBI/MCBI/FTD-dem). The classes are then related to tracheostomy-free survival (Kaplan-Meier, Cox HR) and to the ALS functional progression rate (logistic regression, OR). 'Disease progression' here is ALS motor-functional decline (ALSFRS-R monthly decline and King's staging, p2), not progressive-vs-stable MCI or MCI-to-AD conversion, and no discrimination figure is reported. A subtype-prognosis association is T4. T6 (descriptive clinical cohort) is also supportable; T2 is not.
Task_Type.quote: Prognostic value was analyzed using Kaplan–Meier survival curves, Cox proportional hazards models, and logistic regression for disease progression.

Category.reason: The data are neuropsychological and behavioural assessments plus clinical scales in a clinical cohort. Genetic screening is marginal.
Category.quote: Participants underwent comprehensive cognitive and behavioral assessments.

Validation_Type.reason: No predictive model is validated; the analyses are survival and logistic associations.
Validation_Type.quote: Cox proportional hazards models, adjusted for key clinical covariates, estimated hazard ratios.

Sample_N_Approx.reason: 201 ALS patients. The number is right, but the registry commentary on the recruitment span is wrong (see notes).
Sample_N_Approx.quote: A prospective cohort of 201 ALS patients was evaluated between January 2018 and July 2024.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: A single-centre ALS clinic in Naples; ADNI is not used.
ADNI_Dependent.quote: 201 patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) were consecutively recruited at the ALS Clinic Centre Federico II University Hospital

notes: The T2 code puts an ALS cohort study, which fits no classifier, into the T1-T3 classification subset (counted as V2, non-ADNI). The Sample_N commentary gets the recruitment span wrong: January 2018 to July 2024 is 78 months, not 67; '67' appears to come from the paper's 67% figure. The parsed N of 201 is right. The population is ALS, and 'MCI' here is an ALS cognitive-classification label.
